stock.description: China Merchants Commercial REIT operates as a Hong Kong-domiciled collective investment scheme, legally structured as a unit trust, and holds authorization pursuant to Section 104 of the Securities and Futures Ordinance (SFO). Its primary objective is to own and invest in premium, revenue-producing commercial real estate assets situated across the People's Republic of China, a geographical scope that encompasses both Hong Kong and Macao, but specifically excludes the CML Cities.
